text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Excitement mounted over the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) as a battle for supremacy among 
the Eternal Big Three—Oguri Cap, Super 
Creek, and Inari One. Amidst the fervor――

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O made up her mind. 
Accepting that pieces of herself were 
slipping away, she decided not to piece 
things back together, but to shatter them 
completely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoping that a new version of herself 
awaited ahead, she made her way toward the 
paddock.
